sourceIdFormat: discipline:path-slug:step (existing endpoint/node key); path IDs omit the step

policy.refund: Recalculate and refund actual recorded DP spent; reselect legal purchases with current class entry prices, prerequisites and level gates. Never infer historical spend from new prices.
policy.grantedDisciplines: Preserve valid culture/background/class discipline grants; path changes grant no free techniques.
policy.levelZero: Rebuild at level 1 or the actual current level; there is no separate level-0 purchase pass.
